title: Drive frank-projects general-purpose application corpus
goal: Recursively inventory the newly accessible Drive frank-projects subtree, classify real application/tool/service patterns that can serve as ClayCode general-purpose compiler/runtime acceptance fixtures, distinguish executable code from notes/generated artifacts, and write a bounded manifest plus non-overlapping reuse/negative-result feedback.
completion_test: Bounded subtree inventory is frozen; material application families are deeply inspected with provenance; each useful candidate maps to a ClayCode application-acceptance class or explicit NOT_REUSABLE reason; branch feedback/receipt written with no invented execution evidence.
